artifacts.name: Cairn-marked Compass
artifacts.text: Old survey marks, still true. The treeline gives up its shortcuts.

artifacts.name: Ashen Bell-clapper
artifacts.text: Blackened but whole. It remembers every ringing the fire tried to take.

artifacts.name: Lantern Towns Ledger
artifacts.text: Fair weights, sharp margins. Every haggler reads it twice.

artifacts.name: Moonwell Seal
artifacts.text: Cold to the touch. Scholars dream clearer with it on the shelf.

artifacts.name: Warden's Oath-ring
artifacts.text: Too small for any living finger now. The watch stands straighter anyway.

artifacts.name: Mason's True Plumb
artifacts.text: It has never lied. Walls raised under it go up plumb and quick.

intelDetails: they march heavy on the next moon.
they will come sooner than the last time.
discoveries: A cairn of white stones, each one carried uphill.
Old survey marks cut into an oak, still true.
A charcoal pit, cold a year, ringed with mushrooms.
A child's tin whistle on the mill cut.
Moon-moth wings pinned to bark in a careful row.
A boundary stone with the old manor's mark.
